items.titleEn: Go Inside Training before N5 return against Everton
items.summaryEn: Watch our first team squad in training before we face the Toffees on Saturday
bodyEn: We'll be back in N5 after back-to-back away games, with Everton making the trip down to north London for a Premier League clash, and you can watch our preparations for the game with Inside Training.
Since returning from the October international break, we've found our stride, winning three games in a row before a pulsating 2-2 draw with Bayern Munich at the Allianz Arena on Wednesday night.
With six wins from seven league games so far this season, we'll be looking to continue our 100% record at Emirates Stadium so far this season.
Press play on the video at the top of the article to watch Mikel Arteta's side in training at the Sobha Realty Training Centre.

items.titleZh: 备战周六对阵埃弗顿，阿森纳发布赛前训练花絮
items.summaryZh: 观看一线队在主场对阵埃弗顿前的训练备战情况。
bodyZh: 经历连续客场作战后，我们将回到N5主场，埃弗顿将前往北伦敦进行一场英超较量，您可以通过赛前训练花絮观看我们的备战情况。
自从十月份国际比赛日回归以来，我们已经找回了状态，取得了三连胜，随后在周三晚上的安联球场与拜仁慕尼黑战成2比2平。
本赛季到目前为止的七场联赛中我们赢了六场，我们将力求延续本赛季在酋长球场的全胜纪录。
点击文章顶部的视频，观看米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在索巴地产训练中心的训练。

items.titleEn: Go Inside Training ahead of north London derby
items.summaryEn: We face rivals Spurs in the first north London derby of the WSL season
bodyEn: We make the short trip to the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium for a north London Derby on Saturday afternoon (12.45pm UK) and you can see how we've been preparing for the occasion with the latest edition of Inside Training.
Having drawn 1-1 with Birmingham City at Emirates Stadium last weekend, we'll be looking to get back to winning ways with a success in the derby.
The last north London derby saw us run out 5-2 winners in N5 with a hat-trick from Alessia Russo, a result we'll be looking to repeat in the other half of north London on Saturday.
Press play on the video at the top of the article to watch us prepare for the derby.

items.titleEn: Preview: Arsenal v Everton
items.summaryEn: Get team news, stats, history, TV coverage, tactics and more in our in-depth guide to our Premier League game at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: We’re back in Premier League action on Saturday (3pm) as Everton head to Emirates Stadium, where we’ll look to claim a seventh straight win on our own patch.

After our midweek draw against Bayern Munich, we can turn our attention back to the league, as Mikel Arteta welcomes his former Toffees manager, David Moyes, to north London hoping to end the day closer to league leaders Manchester City than we started.

Both teams enter this game having been beaten just once this term, while the Toffees haven’t lost on the road. They would be delighted to leave N5 with that record intact, having emerged victorious in just one of their last 30 away Premier League matches against us.
HARD TO BEAT

After a second consecutive 13th-place finish last term, Everton remained thrifty in the summer, spending less on new players than they did in recuperating £65m from the sale of winger Iliman Ndiaye to Manchester City. New additions include Hayden Hackney from Middlesbrough and former Gunners Ainsley Maitland-Niles and Christian Norgaard, while Jack Grealish returned for a second loan spell.

The prospects for an improved campaign are encouraging, despite their unbeaten start ending with a 2-0 home defeat to Chelsea last weekend. They enter this round of games in eighth position with 10 points, including Merseyside wins over Crystal Palace and Ipswich Town, plus a late 2-2 draw against Manchester United.

However the Toffees are winless in their last eight league away games, with all three this season ending level – 1-1 at Bournemouth, 0-0 at Tottenham and 2-2 at Hull City. They have also progressed to the fourth round of the Carabao Cup after knocking out Wolves and Preston North End.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY

Arteta: "We’re having three games in six days so we know what’s happening, especially when the games are so demanding and the necessity is to win. We know that, so we prepare the players for those scenarios and do the best we possibly can.

"I know David so well and how he sets the team, the quality they have in their organisation and individually. It’s no coincidence they didn’t lose before their last game. They have a really good team, which we know because in recent clashes, it’s always been a really difficult game for us."

Moyes: It's not an easy game and never has been over many years. We look forward to it; they had a game in midweek, and we have to try and capitalise on that. I thought we did really well last year against them; we played really well down at Arsenal, and I hope we can do the same.

"When I look back at the team we had out, we were pretty threadbare at that time, but we did a good job, and I hope we can do it again. Obviously Arsenal have some nany different tools in their bag and people they can use in different positions, so we're fully aware of the team we're up against and the level."
TEAM NEWS

Bukayo Saka came off early on against Bayern Munich on Wednesday night with a quad issue, which Mikel Arteta has suggested will continue to be assessed by specialists over the coming days, but he will miss this game.
Piero Hincapie is back in training after his ankle injury, but Christos Tzolis (hamstring) and William Saliba (back) are continuing their recoveries.

Moyes meanwhile has indicated he has a few injury issues of his own, which could include Jarrad Branthwaite after his heavy collision with Emiliano Martinez last weekend, which left the Chelsea goalkeeper with a broken jaw.

Former Gunner Christian Norgaard recovered from a groin injury to make a belated debut against the Blues, but Moyes believes he isn't quite match-fit yet, while it remains to be seen if another familiar face in Ainsley Maitland-Niles lines up against us, or whether Jake O’Brien starts at right-back.
TALKING TACTICS

Adrian Clarke, writing in the official matchday programme: Overall, Everton have a balanced style, but physicality and aggression are always at the heart of what they do best. Centre-backs James Tarkowski and Branthwaite want to dominate their duels and lay the foundation for the rest of the side to thrive. The duo, alongside striker Thierno Barry, boast serious aerial power, with three set-piece goals registered already.

A new-look central midfield of the technically excellent James Garner and 19-year-old Harrison Armstrong is also functioning extremely well. With Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall also working in close proximity, the engine room is an area of the pitch Everton aren't dominated in too often.

Pressing has become a core part of their armoury. While they are content to drop deep and defend their own box when necessary, the Merseysiders are also not afraid to hunt in packs higher up the pitch. They have enjoyed a joint league-high 14 shot-ending high turnovers so far, and are very dangerous in those situations.

Moyes will be disappointed with their finishing. They have created an impressive 22 big chances but have converted just four into goals. The full-back areas are also slightly concerning, with multiple errors from them leading to goals.
FACTS AND STATS
We are unbeaten in our last seven Premier League matches against Everton, our best run against the Toffees since going 13 without defeat between December 2007 and December 2013.
Under David Moyes, the Toffees have never won away at us in 13 league attempts.
No side have conceded fewer Premier League goals than us this season, while we have also faced fewer shots on target (21) and have a lower xG against (5.6) than any other side.
Everton have conceded just once in the first half, fewer than any other Premier League team. Meanwhile, each of our last six goals in the competition have come after half-time.
We have won our last two Premier League games against Everton without conceding a goal; only in March 1999 have we achieved three in a row in the competition.
Everton are winless in six Premier League games in London (D3 L3), failing to score in their last two.

Martin Odegaard has made more line-breaking passes leading to a goal than any other player in the Premier League. He has also been directly involved in four goals (2 goals, 2 assists) in his last four Premier League home games against Everton.
Declan Rice has assisted four of our last six league goals, with the last three being match-winning goal contributions.
MATCH OFFICIALS

Tony Harrington has been given this game, which is only the fourth time he has refereed us. We have won the previous three, a 3-1 success against Southampton in October 2024, a 2-0 win against Brentford last December and the 4-1 FA Cup triumph at Portsmouth the following month.

The Yorkshireman is better known to the Toffees, who have only lost three of 12 games he’s presided over. They have won the last three, which have all been on the road, including victories at Old Trafford, Villa Park and a Carabao Cup victory at Preston back in August. His three top-flight outings this term have seen 10 yellow cards, one red and two penalties.
Referee: Tony HarringtonAssistants: Adrian Holmes, Lee BettsFourth official: Ruebyn RicardoVAR: Stuart AttwellAssistant VAR: Tom Nield
EVERTON’S RECENT VISITS

The Toffees haven’t enjoyed playing at Highbury and Emirates Stadium in the Premier League era, winning just two of their 34 trips, in 1996 and 2021. Indeed, they have lost 10 of their last 12 visits, during which time we’ve scored 30 goals, or an average of 2.5 per game.

Last season’s encounter will live long in the memory as we left it late to snatch a priceless victory, with Viktor Gyokeres netting in the 89th minute before Max Dowman became the Premier League’s youngest-ever scorer with his first Gunners goal.

The season before brought a goalless draw in December 2024, while in May 2024 we faced each other on the final day of the season. The visitors did take the lead when Idrissa Gueye saw a free-kick deflect past David Raya, but still in with a chance of the title, we came back and Takehiro Tomiyasu equalised before Kai Havertz grabbed a late winner.
LIVE COVERAGE
With the game not being shown on UK TV, the only place to enjoy dedicated build-up is on Arsenal.com and The Arsenal app (download now on iOS/Android) with Live From N5!

Nicole Holliday and Timbsy will be at Emirates Stadium, joined in the studio by musicians Mike D and Cristale to get their take on all-things Arsenal. There will be a look back at Myles Lewis-Skelly's appearance on the Live at Sobha sofa, while Frimmy will be pitchside with Adrian Clarke to get the lowdown ahead of the game.
After the usual fun, games and quizzes, Clarkey will join Dan Roebuck behind the mics to commentate on all the on-pitch action, so tune in!
You can also find out which broadcaster is showing the action live, wherever you are in the world.

items.titleZh: 赛事前瞻：阿森纳主场迎战埃弗顿
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳将在酋长球场迎战埃弗顿，力争联赛主场七连胜。
bodyZh: 我们在周六下午3点重返英超赛场，埃弗顿将做客酋长球场，我们将力争在主场取得各项赛事七连胜。
在周中与拜仁慕尼黑战平后，我们将注意力重新转回联赛。米克尔·阿尔特塔将在北伦敦迎战他的前太妃糖主帅大卫·莫耶斯，希望能在比赛结束后拉近与领头羊曼城的积分差距。
双方在本赛季均仅输过一场比赛，而太妃糖在客场保持不败。他们在过去30个英超客场对阵我们的比赛中仅赢过一场，此番来到N5区若能延续客场不败金身将会非常高兴。
难以被击败
在连续第二个赛季获得第13名后，埃弗顿在夏天保持了精打细算，新球员的引援花销甚至少于出售边锋伊利曼·恩迪亚耶给曼城所收回的6500万英镑。新援包括来自米德尔斯堡的海登·哈克尼以及前阿森纳球员艾因斯利·梅特兰-内尔斯和克里斯蒂安·诺尔高，而杰克·格拉利什则开启了第二次租借回归。
尽管他们上周末在主场0比2不敌切尔西，结束了开局不败的势头，但他们本赛季提升排名的前景依然令人鼓舞。他们目前以10分排在积分榜第八位，其中包括在默西塞德郡击败水晶宫和伊普斯维奇镇，以及晚期2比2战平曼联。
然而，太妃糖在最近八个联赛客场中难求一胜，本赛季的三个客场全部打平：1比1战平伯恩茅斯，0比0战平托特纳姆热刺，2比2战平赫尔城。他们还在淘汰狼队和普雷斯顿后晋级了联赛杯第四轮。
主教练言论
阿尔特塔：“我们在六天内要踢三场比赛，所以我们清楚情况会怎样，尤其是当比赛要求极高且必须取胜时。我们知道这一点，因此我们为这些情况做好了球员准备，并竭尽全力。”
“我非常了解大卫以及他是如何部署球队的，他们在组织和个人能力上都具备水准。他们上一场比赛前保持不败绝非巧合。他们是一支非常优秀的球队，我们对此很清楚，因为在最近的交锋中，对我们来说总是非常艰难的比赛。”
莫耶斯：“这从来都不是一场轻松的比赛，多年来一直如此。我们很期待；他们周中有比赛，我们必须设法利用这一点。我认为我们去年对阵他们时表现得很好；我们在阿森纳客场踢得非常出色，我希望这次也能做到。”
“回看我们当时派出的阵容，那个时候可以说是捉襟见肘，但我们做得很好，我希望我们能再次做到。显然阿森纳有很多不同的战术武器，并且有可以在不同位置发挥作用的人选，所以我们充分了解我们所面对的球队和水平。”
球队新闻
布卡约·萨卡在周三晚对阵拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中因股四头肌问题提前下场，米克尔·萨卡暗示专家将在未来几天继续评估他的伤情，但他将缺席本场比赛。
皮埃罗·辛卡皮埃在脚踝受伤后恢复了训练，但克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯（腿筋）和威廉·萨利巴（背部）仍在继续康复中。
与此同时，莫耶斯表示他自己也有一些伤病问题，这可能包括贾拉德·布兰思韦特，他在上周末与埃米利奥诺·马丁内斯的剧烈碰撞中受伤，导致这位切尔西门将下巴骨折。
前阿森纳球员克里斯蒂安·诺尔高已从腹股沟伤势中恢复并在对阵切尔西的比赛中完成首秀，但莫耶斯认为他的比赛状态尚未完全恢复；而另一位熟人艾因斯利·梅特兰-内尔斯是否会对阵我们，或者杰克·奥布赖恩是否会首发出任右后卫，还有待观察。
战术探讨
阿德里安·克拉克在官方比赛日场刊中写道：总体而言，埃弗顿拥有均衡的风格，但身体对抗和侵略性始终是他们核心优势的基石。中后卫詹姆斯·塔科夫斯基和布兰思韦特希望统治他们的对抗，并为全队的发展奠定基础。两人与前锋蒂尔诺·巴里一起，拥有出色的空中优势，已经通过定位球打入三球。
由技术出色的詹姆斯·加纳和19岁小将哈里森·阿姆斯特朗组成的新中场组合也运转得非常出色。由于基尔南·德斯伯里-豪尔也在附近活动，中场是埃弗顿不常处于劣势的区域。
高位逼抢已成为他们武器库的核心部分。虽然他们在必要时乐意回收防线并保护自己的禁区，但默西塞德郡球队也并不害怕在前场集体围抢。他们目前并列拥有联赛最高的14次导致射门的高位抢断，在这些情况下非常危险。
莫耶斯对他们的终结能力会感到失望。他们创造了多达22次绝佳机会，但仅将其中4次转化为进球。边后卫区域也稍有隐患，他们多次失误导致了丢球。
事实与数据
我们在过去七场对阵埃弗顿的英超比赛中保持不败，这是自2007年12月至2013年12月创下13场不败以来对阵太妃糖的最佳战绩。
在大卫·莫耶斯的带领下，太妃糖在13次客场挑战我们的联赛中从未取胜。
本赛季没有哪支球队的英超失球数比我们少，同时我们面对的射门次数（21次）和预期失球数（5.6）也是所有球队中最少的。
埃弗顿在上半场仅丢一球，少于任何其他英超球队。与此同时，我们在该项赛事中的最近六个进球全部来自下半场。
我们在最近两场英超对阵埃弗顿的比赛中取胜且未失一球；只有在1999年3月，我们才在赛事中取得过对他们的连续三场零封取胜。
埃弗顿在伦敦的六场英超比赛中未尝胜绩（3平3负），且最近两场未能破门。
马丁·厄德高送出的制造进球的穿透性传球多于英超任何其他球员。他在最近四场英超主场对阵埃弗顿的比赛中直接参与了四个进球（2球2助攻）。
德克兰·赖斯助攻了我们最近六个联赛进球中的四个，最后三个是决定比赛胜负的进球贡献。
比赛官员
托尼·哈灵顿将执法本场比赛，这也是他第四次主裁我们的比赛。此前三场我们全部获胜：2024年10月3比1战胜南安普顿，去年12月2比0战胜布伦特福德，以及次月在足总杯4比1大胜朴茨茅斯。
这位约克郡裁判对太妃糖更加熟悉，在他执法的12场比赛中他们只输了三场。他们赢得了最近的三场比赛，全部是在客场，包括在老特拉福德、维拉公园的胜利以及8月份在普雷斯顿的联赛杯胜利。他本赛季的三场顶级联赛执法已经出示了10张黄牌、1张红牌和2个点球。
主裁判：托尼·哈灵顿；助理裁判：阿德里安·霍姆斯、李·贝茨；第四官员：鲁宾·里卡多；视频助理裁判：斯图尔特·阿特维尔；助理视频助理裁判：汤姆·尼尔德
埃弗顿近期造访
在英超时代，太妃糖并不喜欢海布里和酋长球场，34次做客仅赢过两次（1996年和2021年）。事实上，他们最近12次造客输了10场，在此期间我们打入了30球，场均2.5球。
上赛季的交锋令人难忘，我们在最后时刻艰难抢下宝贵胜利，维克托·吉奥克雷斯在第89分钟破门，随后马克斯·多曼凭借他的第一个枪手进球成为英超历史上最年轻的进球者。
前一个赛季带来了2024年12月的互交白卷，而在2024年5月，我们在赛季最后一天相遇。伊drissa Gueye的任意球折射越过大卫·雷亚取得领先，但仍保留争冠希望的我们完成反超，富安健洋扳平比分，随后凯·哈弗茨攻入绝杀。
现场转播
由于本场比赛不在英国电视上播出，欣赏专属赛前节目的唯一地方是在Arsenal.com和阿森纳官方App（现已在iOS/Android上架）上收看来自N5的现场直播！
妮可·霍利迪和蒂姆布西将亲临酋长球场，音乐人迈克·D和克里斯塔莱也将做客演播室，分享他们对阿森纳一切事物的看法。节目将回顾迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利在Sobha沙发直播上的亮相，而弗里米将与阿德里安·克拉克一起在场边为您带来赛前独家内幕。
在常规的趣味游戏和问答之后，克拉克将与丹·罗巴克一起在麦克风后解说场上的所有精彩对局，敬请收看！
您还可以在世界任何地方查找转播您所在地比赛的电视台。

items.titleEn: Preview: Tottenham Hotspur v Arsenal Women
items.summaryEn: The first Women’s Super League north London derby of the season takes place at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium at 12.45pm on Saturday.
bodyEn: The first Women’s Super League north London derby of the season takes place at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium at 12.45pm on Saturday.
We’re looking to get back to winning ways following the weekend’s 1-1 draw at home to Birmingham City.
Almost 4,000 Arsenal supporters have bought their tickets to sell out a huge away end!
GOALS AT EITHER END
Our local rivals are fourth in the WSL ahead of the weekend, having enjoyed a mostly positive start to the 2026/27 campaign.
Wins over West Ham United (3-1), Crystal Palace (7-0), Aston Villa (4-0) and a 1-1 draw with Liverpool saw Martin Ho crowned Manager of the Month for September.
That form hasn’t continued into October though, with Spurs losing 6-1 at home to London City Lionesses before being beaten 6-2 away to Chelsea.
In the Subway Players Cup, they’ve drawn 0-0 at home to West Ham before losing 4-3 on penalties, and beat Brighton & Hove Albion 1-0 away.
Former Gunner Victoria Pelova is their top scorer in all competitions with four goals, having arrived at the club in the summer.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY

Slegers: “They play high-risk, high-reward football - that’s their identity. I can’t go into their camp and know what they’re thinking, but they have a strong identity and could play the way they’ve been playing. Let’s see tomorrow.

“Being faster is absolutely something we’ve worked on, because we know last year we played a lot against low blocks and compact organisations. Looking for moments we can go faster and be unpredictable is something we’ve looked to add to our game." - Read every word of Renée’s pre-Tottenham Hotspur press conference.

Ho: “These are the games you want to play in, the players want to play in. You have so many different aspects, so there's a lot of excitement around the group, the staff and around the club and we are really excited to get going on Saturday."

"You have to play the game, not the occasion and not get wrapped up in everything that's going on before it or during it. Make sure we're more robust and we show more steel in certain parts of the game defensively. Accept that we will suffer at times against a good Arsenal team but also make sure we apply ourselves correctly with the ball. We're brave, we show personality with it and we do what we usually do."
TEAM NEWS

Daphne van Domselaar will be back in the squad. "It’s too early to play," Renée said, "but we want to get her back in the routine with the team and she’ll do the warm-up." Kim Little is unavailable as she's managing a knock, and Chloe Kelly isn’t yet ready to play. Katie Reid is training with the team, and Michelle Agyemang is working on her recovery in the background.
For Tottenham, Jess Naz is back in contention after recovering from an ACL injury, while Olga Ahtinen remains sidelined with a knock and Clare Hunt continues to recover from her injury.
FACTS AND STATS
We have won 10 of our 13 north London derbies in the WSL (D2 L1), scoring five goals in our last two wins: 5-0 in February 2025, 5-2 in March 2026.

Spurs are only the second team in WSL history to concede six or more goals in back-to-back games, after Doncaster Rovers Belles in 2013. Each of Spurs’ last four defeats have all seen them concede at least five goals, the longest ever run in the competition by any side.

Renee Slegers is unbeaten in all 17 of her WSL games against English managers (W11 D6), with only Sonia Bompastor (18 – faces Jo Potter on MD7) facing English coaches more often without losing in the competition.
Alessia Russo has scored more WSL goals against Spurs (8) than any other opponent.
MATCH OFFICIALS
Phoebe Cross has been appointed to take charge of Saturday’s derby. She has seen over five WSL matches so far this season, handing out 17 yellow cards and no reds in the process.
One of them was our 0-0 draw at home to Crystal Palace in September.

HOW TO WATCH
Supporters in the UK can watch this match live on BBC One, BBC iPlayer and the BBC Sport website.
For those elsewhere, take a look at our how to watch article for a list of broadcasters around the world.

items.titleZh: 赛事前瞻：热刺女足对阵阿森纳女足
items.summaryZh: 本赛季首场女足英超北伦敦德比将于周六中午在热刺球场打响。
bodyZh: 本赛季首场女足英超北伦敦德比将于周六中午12点45分在热刺球场打响。
在经历周末主场1-1战平伯明冈城后，我们正力求重回胜利轨道。
近4,000名阿森纳球迷已购票，客队看台门票售罄！
两端球门的交锋
在迎来本周末的比赛前，我们的同城死敌在女足英超中排名第四，2026/27赛季的开局总体较为积极。
凭借战胜西汉姆联（3-1）、水晶宫（7-0）、阿斯顿维拉（4-0）以及与利物浦1-1战平的战绩，马丁·霍（Martin Ho）当选9月最佳主教练。
不过这一状态并未延续到10月，热刺在主场1-6惨败给伦敦城雌狮，随后客场2-6不敌切尔西。
在地铁球员杯中，他们主场0-0战平西汉姆联后点球3-4失利，客场1-0击败了布莱顿。
前阿森纳球员维多利亚·佩洛娃（Victoria Pelova）在夏季加盟后，目前以4粒进球成为队内各项赛事头号射手。
主教练言论
斯勒格尔（Slegers）：“他们踢的是高风险、高回报的足球——这就是他们的风格。我无法进入他们的阵营去了解他们的想法，但他们有着鲜明的风格，并且可能会延续以往的踢法。让我们明天拭目以待。”
“加快节奏绝对是我们一直在努力的方向，因为我们知道去年我们经常面对低位防守和密集的阵型。寻找能够提速并变得不可预测的时刻，是我们希望为比赛增加的内容。”——阅读雷妮（Renée）赛前新闻发布会的全部内容。
霍（Ho）：“这些是你渴望参与的比赛，也是球员们渴望参与的比赛。这里有许多不同的层面，因此整个团队、教练组以及俱乐部上下都充满兴奋感，我们非常期待周六的到来。”
“你必须专注于比赛本身，而不是场外盛况，不要被赛前或比赛期间的各种杂音所干扰。我们要确保在防守的某些环节表现得更加稳健、更有韧性。接受在面对强大的阿森纳时我们有时会陷入被动，但同时也要确保我们在控球时正确执行战术。我们要保持勇敢，展现个性，做我们平时一直在做的事。”
球队新闻
达芙妮·范多姆斯拉尔（Daphne van Domselaar）将重返大名单。“现在上场还为时过早，”雷妮表示，“但我们希望让她重新融入球队的日常训练，她将参与热身。”金·利尔（Kim Little）因受轻伤将缺席，而克洛伊·凯利（Chloe Kelly）尚未准备好出场。凯蒂·里德（Katie Reid）正随队训练，米歇尔·阿吉曼（Michelle Agyemang）则在幕后进行康复训练。
对于热刺而言，杰斯·纳兹（Jess Naz）在从前十字韧带伤势中恢复后重返大名单，而奥尔加·阿赫蒂宁（Olga Ahtinen）因轻伤继续缺阵，克莱尔·亨特（Clare Hunt）仍在从伤病中恢复。
事实与数据
我们在女足英超的13场北伦敦德比中赢下了10场（2平1负），在最近的两场胜利中均打入五球：2025年2月以5-0取胜，2026年3月以5-2取胜。
热刺是女足英超历史上第二支在背靠背比赛中失球达到或超过6个的球队，上一支是2013年的唐卡斯特流浪者贝尔斯。热刺最近的四场失利中每场丢球都至少达到5个，这是该赛事中任何球队遭遇的最长此类纪录。
雷妮·斯勒格尔（Renee Slegers）执教女足英超对阵英格兰籍主教练的17场比赛中保持不败（11胜6平），在赛事中面对英格兰教练次数最多且未尝败绩的仅次于索尼娅·邦帕斯托（Sonia Bompastor，18场——将在第7轮对阵乔·波特）。
阿莱西亚·鲁索（Alessia Russo）在女足英超中对阵热刺时打进的进球数（8个）多于对阵任何其他对手。
比赛官员
菲比·克罗斯（Phoebe Cross）被任命执法周六的德比战。她本赛季迄今已执法了五场多女足英超比赛，出示了17张黄牌，没有红牌。
其中一场包括我们在9月份主场0-0战平水晶宫的比赛。
主裁判：菲比·克罗斯（Phoebe Cross）助理裁判：乔恩·阿什沃思-塞尔斯（Jon Ashworth-Sears）和马修·乔伊斯（Matthew Joyce）第四官员：莉萨·本恩（Lisa Benn）

items.titleEn: Renée: “We need to do it for the fans”
items.summaryEn: Nearly 4,000 Arsenal supporters will be making their way to the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium for Saturday
bodyEn: Nearly 4,000 Arsenal supporters will be making their way to the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium for Saturday’s north London derby in the Women’s Super League.
We’ve sold out a huge away allocation for the 12.45pm kick-off against our local rivals as we look to get back to winning ways following last weekend’s 1-1 draw at home to Birmingham City.
In her pre-match press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Friday, Renée Slegers spoke about using our support as fuel and motivation.

“Our focus is on the here and now, this game, there’s nothing else that we think about,” she said. “We have a sold-out away section, we need to fight on the pitch for 90-plus minutes, and we need to do it for the fans because we need to do more for them. It’s our biggest fuel in the game, to give everything for the fans.

“Being faster is absolutely something we’ve worked on, because we know last year we played a lot against low blocks and compact organisations. Looking for moments we can go faster and be unpredictable is something we’ve looked to add to our game. There are times we’ve had to chase a goal in almost every game we’ve played so far, where we go more optimistic and get into certain spaces just to get the ball into the box.

“I think how we look to dominate in possession, be unpredictable and fluid with our positioning, how we break lines, get a lot of bodies forward in attack - all those things. I think what you’ve seen is we haven’t rewarded ourselves at the final stage. I think it’s about both boxes, where we’ve been vulnerable at the back with a couple of breaks, when opposition comes through it goes fast, and we need to manage that better. It’s really about both boxes and what happens in between, we absolutely need to maintain both sides and it must be better.

“We've stated where we are. We've stated reality and it's exactly the same. What we need to do right now is focus game by game and the next one is the north London derby. It's been a good week. We've finally had some time and it's not only about talking and meeting and those things. For us, it's been more about actions. So we've had a really good training week where we've rescheduled a little bit and where we've really had the time spent on the pitch. So that's been really good for us. Today, a very sharp session and we look forward to tomorrow.”

Martin Ho’s side will be hoping they can shut up shop defensively first and foremost, having conceded 12 goals across their last two matches - 6-2 and 6-1 defeats to Chelsea and London City Lionesses respectively,.

Asked if Spurs might over correct and opt for a more defensive approach against us, our head coach continued: “They play high-risk, high-reward football - that’s their identity. I can’t go into their camp and know what they’re thinking, but they have a strong identity and could play the way they’ve been playing. Let’s see tomorrow.”

items.titleZh: 雷妮：“我们需要为了球迷拼搏”
items.summaryZh: 近四千名阿森纳球迷将前往热刺球场观看北伦敦德比。
bodyZh: 近四千名阿森纳球迷将前往托特纳姆热刺球场，观看周六进行的女子英超联赛北伦敦德比。
我们已经售罄了这场12点45分开球的客场比赛的巨大门票配额，此前我们在上周末主场1-1战平伯明翰城，现在正力求重返胜利轨道。
周五，雷妮·斯莱格斯在索巴地产训练中心出席赛前新闻发布会时，谈到了将球迷的支持转化为动力和燃料。
她表示：“我们的焦点在于此时此刻、这场比赛，我们没有去想其他任何事情。我们拥有售罄的客场球迷区，我们需要在球场上为之拼搏90多分钟，我们需要为球迷做到这一点，因为我们需要为他们做得更多。这是我们在比赛中最大的动力，那就是为球迷付出一切。”
“踢得更快绝对是我们一直在努力的方向，因为我们知道去年我们经常面对低位防守和紧凑的阵型。寻找我们可以加快节奏并变得不可预测的时刻，是我们希望为比赛增添的要素。到目前为止，在几乎每场比赛中我们都有不得不追赶比分的时候，这时我们会变得更具攻击性，并进入特定的空间将球传进禁区。”
“我认为我们在控球时如何占据主导地位，如何在跑位上保持不可预测和流畅，如何打破防线，如何在进攻中投入大量兵力——所有这些事情都是如此。我认为大家看到的是，我们在最后阶段没有得到回报。我认为这关乎两个禁区，我们在后防线上因为几次反击而显得脆弱，当对手突破时速度很快，我们需要更好地应对这一点。这确实关乎两个禁区以及期间发生的事情，我们绝对需要兼顾两端，而且必须做得更好。”
“我们已经说明了我们所处的位置。我们说明了现实，情况完全一样。我们现在需要做的是一场一场地专注于比赛，下一场就是北伦敦德比。这是不错的一周。我们终于有了一些时间，不仅仅是开会和交流。对我们来说，这更多的是付诸行动。因此我们度过了非常棒的一周训练，我们稍微调整了日程，真正把时间花在了球场上。这对我们来说真的很好。今天进行了一堂非常敏锐的训练课，我们期待着明天的到来。”
马丁·霍的球队首先希望在防守端做好防守，他们最近两场比赛共失12球——分别以2-6和6-1的比分输给切尔西和伦敦城雌狮。
当被问及热刺是否会矫枉过正并选择对我们采取更保守的防守战术时，我们的主教练继续说道：“他们踢的是高风险、高回报的足球——这就是他们的风格。我无法进入他们的阵营去了解他们在想什么，但他们拥有鲜明的风格，并且可能会继续以他们一直以来的方式踢球。让我们拭目以待明天的比赛。”

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has expressed concern over Bukayo Saka’s robustness after a series of injuries to the forward in the past year and as he awaits further news on how long he will be out for with a thigh issue.

Saka is set for an MRI scan after limping off in the 2-2 draw with Bayern Munich in the Champions League, with Arteta revealing the 25-year-old had “quite a lot of fluid in the area so it was difficult to understand the extent of the injury”. Saka will definitely miss Saturday’s game against Evertonand, it is understood, Arsenal fear it could be a grade-two tear that could potentially keep him out for up to six weeks.

Saka missed a large portion of last season due to hamstring, hip and achilles tendon injuries having also been sidelined by another hamstring issue in 2024-25. In total, he has had 11 different injuries since September 2023 and Arteta insisted that he has been trying to ease his workload as a result. “It’s certainly been different in the last year or so,” the Spaniard said when asked if Saka remains robust enough to start every match. “The demands that we are putting on every player are immense. The amount of games, the intensity of those matches, the international competitions, the times as well between games are getting narrower.

“Bukayo against Lille [in the Champions League last week] didn’t start the game because we knew what was happening. We have to play three times in less than six days. And especially when the games are so demanding, until the last minute you are there, you are chasing the game, you want to win. The necessity is to win every game, so we know that. So we are preparing the players for those scenarios and we do the best that we possibly can.”

Saka missed only three Premier League matches in three seasons between 2021 and 2024 and broke the Arsenal club record by playing in 83 consecutive top-flight games. He is already approaching 300 appearances for the club he joined as a seven-year-old and was rewarded with a lucrative new contract in February that made him one of the highest-paid players in the club’s history.

Asked whether he feared Saka could suffer from burnout having made his Arsenal debut three months after his 17th birthday, Arteta said: “I don’t have that feeling at all but something we have to be very mindful of is to create the right ecosystem around the player to fulfil his qualities. We really need to understand, whenever he comes back, how we are going to manage his load, what he is capable of to sustain having an impact in the team.”

Saka’s absence could hand an opportunity to Max Dowman on Saturday. The 16-year-old has played only nine minutes in the league this season and Arteta feels sure he is ready to make an impact after he became the youngest goalscorer in Premier League history, against David Moyes’s side in March.

“There is something inevitable to go back to that memory and the feeling of the moment. That’s with us, that’s going to stay in that stadium for a long, long time,” said Arteta. “He’s training and every time he’s got a moment to play, he’s showing that he’s a player that is going to impact the game. For sure he’s going to have minutes.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔担忧萨卡耐用性，这名前锋可能缺阵六周
items.summaryZh: 萨卡因大腿伤势面临核磁共振检查，阿森纳担心他可能缺阵长达六周。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔对布卡约·萨卡在过去一年中遭遇的一系列伤病表达了担忧，同时正等待关于他因大腿问题将缺阵多久的进一步消息。
在欧冠2比2战平拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中，萨卡因伤瘸拐离场，即将接受核磁共振扫描。阿尔特塔透露，这位25岁球员的患处“有相当多的积液，因此很难了解伤势的严重程度”。萨卡将确定缺席周六对阵埃弗顿的比赛，据了解，阿森纳担心这可能是二级撕裂，并可能让他缺阵长达六周。

萨卡在2024-25赛季曾因另一次腿筋问题缺阵，并且在上赛季因腿筋、臀部和跟腱伤病错过了大部分比赛。自2023年9月以来，他总共遭遇了11次不同的伤病，阿尔特塔坚称他因此一直在试图减轻萨卡的工作负荷。这位西班牙教练在被问及萨卡是否依然足够强壮以首发出战每场比赛时表示：“在过去的一年左右里，情况确实不同了。我们对每一位球员提出的要求都是巨大的。比赛的数量、比赛的强度、国际赛事，以及比赛之间的间隔时间也越来越短。”
“布卡约上周在欧冠对阵里尔的比赛中没有首发，因为我们知道发生了什么。我们不得不在不到六天的时间里踢三场比赛。特别是当比赛要求如此之高时，直到最后一分钟你都在场上，你在追赶比赛，你想要赢球。赢下每一场比赛是必须的，所以我们深知这一点。因此我们正在为这些情况让球员做好准备，并且我们在尽最大努力。”
在2021年至2024年的三个赛季中，萨卡只缺席了三场英超联赛，并以连续出战83场顶级联赛打破了阿森纳俱乐部的队史纪录。他在七岁时加入这家俱乐部，目前即将迎来代表俱乐部的第300次出场，并在二月份获得了一份丰厚的新合同，成为俱乐部历史上薪水最高的球员之一。
当被问及是否担心萨卡在17岁生日后三个月完成阿森纳首秀后会出现职业倦怠时，阿尔特塔表示：“我完全没有这种感觉，但我们必须非常注意的一点是，在球员周围建立正确的生态系统以发挥他的特质。无论他何时复出，我们真的需要了解我们将如何管理他的负荷，以及他有能力维持对球队产生怎样的影响。”
萨卡的缺阵可能会在周六给马克斯·唐曼带来机会。这位16岁的小将在本赛季的联赛中仅出场过9分钟，阿尔特塔坚信他已准备好产生影响，此前他在三月份对阵大卫·莫耶斯的球队时成为了英超历史上最年轻的进球者。
“有一种不可避免的感觉会让人回到那段记忆和当时的感受中。那是属于我们的，并将在这座球场里留存很长时间，”阿尔特塔说道。“他在训练中，而且每次得到上场时间时，他都在证明自己是一名能够对比赛产生影响的球员。他肯定会获得出场时间的。”

items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers was back in front of the media for her pre-Spurs press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Friday
bodyEn: Renée Slegers was back in front of the media for her pre-Tottenham Hotspur press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Friday.
Our head coach looked ahead to Saturday's north London derby, shared the latest team news and more.
Here's everything she had to say on the following subjects...

on the latest team news regarding Kelly, Van Domselaar, Reid, Agyemang and Little:We have the same squad available as we had against Birmingham. Daphne will be in the squad, it’s too early to play, but we want to get her back in the routine with the team and she’ll do the warm-up. Kim is managing a knock as well, we hope to have her back soon but she won’t make it this weekend. Chloe isn’t yet ready to play, Katie is training with the team now and looks really good. Mich is working in the background, so that’s everything so far.

on if Spurs might over correct after conceding a lot of goals lately:They play high-risk, high-reward football - that’s their identity. I can’t go into their camp and know what they’re thinking, but they have a strong identity and could play the way they’ve been playing. Let’s see tomorrow.

on if seeing less of 4-4-2 out of possession has been deliberate:Different reasons, a little bit with personnel. I think you’ve seen that block in certain phases, but we’ve also done other things, looking to see how we can stop things and create things. We’re aware we need to be better in our counter-attacking moments, both from lower areas on the pitch and also higher up, because we do a lot of good work out of possession in the attacking half - we want to create more chances from that. It’s different games with different gameplans.

on elements of the game we’ve worked on:Being faster is absolutely something we’ve worked on, because we know last year we played a lot against low blocks and compact organisations. Looking for moments we can go faster and be unpredictable is something we’ve looked to add to our game. There are times we’ve had to chase a goal in almost every game we’ve played so far, where we go more optimistic and get into certain spaces just to get the ball into the box.

on Pelova’s start at Spurs and our huge away following tomorrow:I think sometimes a change in your life can get something new out of you. Of course, I care for Vic and that she plays and does well. We're looking forward to seeing her tomorrow, but our focus is on the here and now, this game, there’s nothing else that we think about. We have a sold-out away section, we need to fight on the pitch for 90-plus minutes, and we need to do it for the fans because we need to do more for them. It’s our biggest fuel in the game, to give everything for the fans.

on what embodies the Arsenal way about how we want to play:I think how we look to dominate in possession, be unpredictable and fluid with our positioning, how we break lines, get a lot of bodies forward in attack - all those things. I think what you’ve seen is we haven’t rewarded ourselves at the final stage. I think it’s about both boxes, where we’ve been vulnerable at the back with a couple of breaks, when opposition comes through it goes fast, and we need to manage that better. It’s really about both boxes and what happens in between, we absolutely need to maintain both sides and it must be better.

on if she’s surprised to still be in the head coach position:That’s not something I think about. It’s about where we are as a group, and what we’re working towards. It’s absolutely not what we wanted or expected eight games into the season, but I’m in the here-and-now. We’re preparing for the north London derby tomorrow, and we have the group together in the same direction - like I just said, the fuel and motivation is sky-high because of the fans that will be there for us. That’s where my focus is.

on what our targets are for the remainder of the season:At the moment, I’m not looking at the table - my mindset is to take it game-by-game. The next one is the north London derby, we look forward to it coming right now, and like I said, the fight we will bring for the fans tomorrow is the only thing we’re thinking about.

on what needs to be the next goal:Like I just said, we’ll go game-by-game and we’re not thinking further ahead, because that’s not where our focus needs to be right now. We’re looking just at the next game, and that’s the north London derby.

on if she’s worried about the reaction if we have a negative result:I can't be thinking about that. Looking back, that was the sound of care, I think, what we heard at the stadium. So many people in the stadium buying a ticket to watch us play and that was the sound of care and the sound of frustration, which was totally to its right. So for tomorrow, like I said, we are blessed with the fans that we have and that they're showing up and that we're selling out the away section and we're going to do it for them because I know how much they want it and I know how much they're invested and that's going to be a big thing for us.

on having a full week in training between matches:We've stated where we are. We've stated reality and it's exactly the same. What we need to do right now is focus game by game and the next one is the north London derby. It's been a good week. We've finally had some time and it's not only about talking and meeting and those things. For us, it's been more about actions. So we've had a really good training week where we've rescheduled a little bit and where we've really had the time spent on the pitch. So that's been really good for us. Today, a very sharp session and we look forward to tomorrow.

on if we can draw from previous experiences with our backs against the wall:Yeah, we know how good we are and can be and it's going to be a big occasion tomorrow. The players love big occasions so it will bring something out of us tomorrow. So yeah, of course we've been talking about that. And then in combination, I've said it so many times with the fans, that's it for me. So in combination with the fans tomorrow.

on if Spurs playing in a different stadium to usual could be an advantage for us:I think it will be a fight on the pitch, wherever it is. I think the pitch will be of high quality and big size, which is good. But yeah, it's all about the fight on the pitch tomorrow. Because like I said, they play high-risk, high-reward football. There's going to be duels and there's going to be 1v1 moments on the pitch and we have to be really good in those moments. So we want to see a fight from the team tomorrow.

on the noise around the derby:I don't know how many I've been a part of now, north London derbies, but it's become special to me as well. After these years at Arsenal, I know what it feels like, what it means for so many people. So I look forward to it. I look forward to the occasion. I look forward to seeing our team in red going against them and giving absolutely everything on the pitch and then again with the fans. So I look forward to the occasion tomorrow.

on if she’s noticed any changes at Spurs this season:I think some things that they're doing this year, which they do well, they did last year as well. Maybe in an even more extreme or at a higher level. So yeah, I think everyone's seen it. When I talk about high risk, high reward, they press and they're not shy to go play every player across the pitch, rotate their players in the middle of the pitch. So they play very brave football, which when they're successful, it's really good. But yeah, of course we see opportunities tomorrow.

on what’s needed for a WSL player to win the Ballon d’Or:Well, they often look at the trophies you win as a team as well and then your individual performances within. So I'd say you're going to have to win trophies, European trophies and be a standout player. And I think there's some really, really good players in this league. So yeah, it will be exciting to see and follow how that's going to play out at the end of the year.

on how important it is to her:Well, to be fair, for me, nothing is really important right now. And the only thing that I'm thinking about is tomorrow. So everything that's bigger and further away, it's not really on my mind at the moment.
on having so many London derbies:This is the biggest game of the season for certain fans, maybe even for players and staff at the club. So this is a special one, absolutely.

on if there’s one great memory that stands out of previous derbies:I think last year was amazing at the Emirates at home. Again, the fight that you feel on the pitch. The fans that are so loud and get so much behind it. I think... The one away, to feel that. That's two seasons ago, to feel that. North London derby at the away stadium and what we can create there. So I think those would be the two standing out for me. I haven't been part of so many now when I think about it.
on if this is the biggest game for our homegrown players:Yeah there’s certainly players in our squad that see this and perceive this game as one of the biggest ones of the season.
on Williamson’s dad being a Spurs fan:Yeah, I believe her dad isn’t making it tomorrow, so the Arsenal side of the family will be there.

on how important it is to get the win tomorrow:Super important, for the run of games that we’ve had, but I’m bringing it back there again, it’s very important for us, for the club, for the fans, for the people that care about Arsenal. Like I said, it’s the most important game, for some people, of the season. It’s an important game, and for us it comes at a good time.

on if there has been more intensity in training this week:Yeah, and it’s also something we’ve asked for, because we’ve had a long week, a seven-day turnaround, we have been able to train hard and train with intensity, which has been really good because it’s going to be needed tomorrow.

on the nature of Kelly’s injury:She has had issues with her hamstring, has had symptoms and there has been some small injury in the hamstring. She’s still not training with the team, she’s not out on the pitch yet, but she’s making good progress in her rehabilitation.

on if it was a hamstring injury:Yeah, there was something found, so we classified it as an injury, and obviously she’s not able to train because of the pain and the symptoms, and we hope that she, as soon as possible, is back fit again and fully ready to go and compete for us again.

on why Russo has been playing in the no.10 role:We look at it holistically. But also I think about Alessia and the role she’s played for us in the 9 and 10 last season, I think she had her best goal-scoring season for Arsenal last season. So she is really good in both positions, and she can finish from both positions, she can absolutely produce goals from both positions. I think, as a team, we have to do everything to get into the right spaces and in good finishing positions to be able to serve all the forwards and all the quality that we have.

on how important it is to get back in the Champions League places:Yeah of course, that’s in the back of our heads, but for where we are now and what we need right now is to get back to winning ways, and we can only do that with the next game in front of us, so that’s why the next game in front of us is the most important right now.

items.summaryZh: 雷妮出席索布哈地产训练基地赛前发布会，展望北伦敦德比并更新球队伤情。
bodyZh: 周五，雷妮·斯勒格斯（Renée Slegers）回到索布哈地产训练基地，出席了对阵托特纳姆热刺的赛前新闻发布会。
我们的主教练展望了周六的北伦敦德比，分享了最新的球队消息等内容。
以下是她就以下话题所说的一切……
关于凯利、范多姆塞拉尔、里德、阿杰芒和莉ittle的最新伤情：我们可用的阵容与对阵伯明翰时相同。达芙妮将进入大名单，现在上场还为时过早，但我们希望让她重新融入球队的日常，她会参加热身。金也有一些小伤，我们希望她能尽快复归，但她将缺席本周末的比赛。克洛伊尚未准备好出场，凯蒂现在正随球队训练，状态看起来非常不错。米奇在幕后努力恢复，这就是目前的所有情况。
关于热刺近期丢球较多后是否会矫枉过正：他们踢的是高风险、高回报的足球——这就是他们的风格。我无法进入他们的阵营去了解他们在想什么，但他们有强烈的风格，并且可能会继续以这种方式踢球。明天拭目以待。
关于无球时较少使用4-4-2阵型是否是有意的：有不同的原因，也有一点人员方面的因素。我想你在某些阶段看到过这种防守阵型，但我们也做过其他尝试，看看如何阻止对手并创造机会。我们意识到我们需要在反击时做得更好，无论是从后场还是前场，因为我们在进攻半场的无球阶段做了很多不错的工作——我们希望从中创造更多机会。不同的比赛有不同的战术计划。
关于我们一直在演练的比赛要素：加快节奏绝对是我们一直在努力的方向，因为我们知道去年我们经常面对低位防守和组织严密的球队。寻找能够提速并变得不可预测的时刻，是我们希望为比赛增添的内容。到目前为止，几乎在我们踢的每场比赛中，都有过需要追赶比分的时刻，这时我们会变得更积极，进入某些空间以便将球传进禁区。
关于佩洛娃在热刺的开局以及明天庞大的客场球迷群体：我认为生活中的改变有时能激发出全新的你。当然，我关心维奇，希望她能出场并表现出色。我们期待明天见到她，但我们的重点在于此时此地，在于这场比赛，没有其他可想的事情。我们的客场门票已经售罄，我们需要在球场上拼搏90多分钟，我们要为球迷而战，因为我们需要为他们做得更多。这是我们在比赛中最大的动力，为球迷付出一切。
关于我们的比赛方式如何体现阿森纳精神：我认为我们如何在控球中占据主导地位，在跑位上保持不可预测和流动性，如何打破对手的防线，将大量兵力压上进攻——所有这些。我认为你们已经看到的是我们在最后阶段没有得到回报。我认为这关乎两个禁区，我们在后防线上因为几次反击而显得脆弱，当对手突破时速度很快，我们需要更好地掌控这一点。这真的关乎两个禁区以及期间发生的事情，我们绝对需要稳固攻防两端，并且必须做得更好。
关于她是否对依然担任主教练职务感到意外：这不是我会去想的事情。这关乎我们作为一个团队处于什么位置，以及我们正在努力实现的目标。这绝对不是我们在赛季进行到第八场时所希望或预期的，但我活在当下。我们在为明天的北伦敦德比做准备，我们的团队朝着同一个方向凝聚在一起——正如我刚才所说，由于将要到来的球迷，我们的动力和积极性高昂。这就是我关注的焦点。
关于我们本赛季剩余时间的宏观目标：目前，我没有看积分榜——我的心态是脚踏一步、一场一场来。下一场是北伦敦德比，我们期待它的到来，就像我刚才说的，明天为球迷拼搏是我们唯一考虑的事情。
关于下一个目标应该是什么：就像我刚才说的，我们将一场一场地踢，不会去想更远的事情，因为那不是我们现在需要关注的焦点。我们只看下一场比赛，那就是北伦敦德比。
关于如果取得负面结果是否会担心外界的反应：我不能去想这些。回想起来，那听起来像是关心，我想，我们在球场听到的声音。体育场里有那么多人买票看我们比赛，那是关心的声音，也是沮丧的声音，这完全合情合理。所以对于明天，就像我说的，我们有幸拥有这样的球迷，他们到场支持，客场球票已经售罄，我们将为他们而战，因为我知道他们有多渴望，我知道他们投入了多少，这对我们来说将是一件大事。

关于在比赛之间获得完整的一周训练时间：我们已经说明了我们的处境。我们阐明了现实，情况完全一样。我们现在需要做的是一场一场地专注，下一场就是北伦敦德比。过去一周过得不错。我们终于有了一些时间，这不仅仅是关于谈话、开会之类的事。对我们来说，这更多是关于实际行动。所以我们度过了一个非常好的训练周，我们稍微调整了日程，真正把时间花在了球场上。这对我们来说真的很好。今天，这是一场非常犀利的训练课，我们期待明天的到来。
关于我们是否能从背水一战的过往经历中汲取经验：是的，我们知道自己有多出色，也能变得多么出色，明天将是一个重大时刻。球员们喜欢重大时刻，这会在明天激发出我们的潜力。所以，是的，我们当然谈论过这一点。然后结合我多次提到过的球迷，对我来说就是这样。所以明天会与球迷的力量相结合。
关于热刺在非常规球场比赛是否可能对我们有利：我认为无论在哪里，这都将是一场场上的拼搏。我认为球场质量很高，尺寸很大，这很好。但是的，这一切都取决于明天的场上拼搏。因为就像我说的，他们踢的是高风险、高回报的足球。球场上会有争抢，会有1v1的时刻，我们必须在这些时刻表现得非常出色。所以我们希望看到球队明天展现出拼搏精神。
关于围绕德比的喧嚣：我不记得自己现在经历过多少次北伦敦德比了，但它对我来说也变得很特殊。在阿森纳度过这些年后，我知道那种感觉是什么，对这么多人来说意味着什么。所以我很期待。我期待这个大日子。我期待看到我们身穿红色战袍的球队迎战他们，在球场上付出全部，然后再次与球迷融为一体。所以我期待明天的盛事。
关于她是否注意到热刺本赛季有任何变化：我认为他们今年做的一些不错的事情，去年也在做。也许表现得更极端，或者达到了更高的水平。所以是的，我想大家都看到了。当我谈到高风险、高回报时，他们会进行压迫，毫不避讳地在球场各个角落派球员去争抢，在球场中路轮换球员。所以他们踢的是非常勇敢的足球，当他们成功时，效果真的很好。但当然，我们看到了明天的机会。
关于WSL球员赢得金球奖需要具备什么：嗯，他们通常也会看你作为团队赢得的奖杯，以及你在其中的个人表现。所以我想说，你必须要赢得奖杯、欧洲赛事的奖杯，并且成为一名出色的球员。我认为这个联赛里有一些非常非常优秀的球员。所以，看到并关注它在年底如何揭晓将会令人兴奋。
关于这（金球奖）对她有多重要：说实话，对我来说，现在没有什么比这更重要了。我唯一想的就是明天。所以所有更宏大、更遥远的事情，目前并不真正在我的脑海中。
关于有如此多的伦敦德比：对某些球迷来说，这绝对是赛季中最重大的比赛，甚至对俱乐部的球员和工作人员来说也是如此。所以这绝对是一场特殊的比赛。
关于以往德比中是否有一个伟大的记忆脱颖而出：我认为去年在酋长球场的比赛令人惊叹。再次感受到球场上的拼搏。球迷们声音震耳欲聋，给予了巨大的支持。我认为……客场的比赛，去感受那种气氛。那是两个赛季前的事，去感受那种气氛。在客场球场的北伦敦德比以及我们在那里能够创造的氛围。所以我想这两场对我来说是最突出的。当我想想时，我并没有经历过那么多次。
关于这是否是本土球员经历过最重大的比赛：是的，我们的阵容中确实有球员将这场比赛视为赛季中最重大的比赛之一。
关于威廉姆斯的父亲是热刺球迷：是的，我相信她的父亲明天不会到场，所以阿森纳阵营的家人将会出席。
关于明天取胜有多重要：超级重要，考虑到我们最近的一连串比赛，但我还是要回到老话题，这对我们、对俱乐部、对球迷、对关心阿森纳的人来说都非常重要。就像我说的，对某些人来说，这是赛季最重要的比赛。这是一场重要的比赛，对我们来说它来得正是时候。
关于本周训练的强度是否有所增加：是的，这也是我们要求的，因为我们有一个漫长的星期，有七天的调整期，我们能够刻苦训练并保持高强度，这真的很好，因为明天会需要这些。
关于凯利伤病的性质：她的腿筋一直有问题，出现了一些症状，腿筋有一些小伤。她目前还不能随队训练，还没有回到球场上，但在康复方面取得了不错的进展。
关于这是否是腿筋拉伤：是的，发现了一些问题，所以我们将其归类为受伤，显然她因为疼痛和症状而无法训练，我们希望她能尽快恢复健康，完全准备好再次为我们出战并竞争。
关于为什么鲁索一直踢10号位：我们从整体来看待这个问题。但我也考虑了阿莱西亚上赛季在9号和10号位上扮演的角色，我认为她上赛季在阿森纳迎来了进球最多的赛季。所以她在两个位置上都非常出色，她能够从这两个位置完成终结，绝对可以从这两个位置上取得进球。我认为，作为一个团队，我们必须尽一切努力进入正确的空间和良好的终结位置，以便为所有的前锋以及我们拥有的所有实力派球员提供支援。
关于重返欧冠区有多重要：是的，当然，这在我们的脑海里，但就我们目前所处的位置以及我们现在所需要的是重回胜利轨道，我们只能通过眼前的下一场比赛来做到这一点，这就是为什么眼前的下一场比赛现在是最重要的。

items.titleEn: Mamdani loves Arsenal. He should challenge them to cut ties with the UAE over Sudan | Sasha Lezhnev and John Prendergast

bodyEn: Like him or not, there is no doubt that New York mayor Zohran Mamdani’s passion for certain issues is electric, and that passion played a large part in him getting elected. But today, two of his biggest passions are on a collision course.

On one hand, Mamdani is now arguably the US’s most high-profile supporter of English Premier League champions Arsenal. A superfan since he was a child, he has put the Gunners into the American spotlight more than anyone since becoming mayor. The Empire State Building gleamed in Arsenal’s red and white when they won the Premier League title. He wrote an essay about what Arsenal’s championship means to him, talks about Arsenal at press conferences and interviews and inaugurated Thierry Henry Way near Times Square in honor of the Arsenal legend.

But another of Mamdani’s passions – standing up against genocide and for human rights – is now presenting a problem for the mayor’s Arsenal fandom. One prominent part of Arsenal’s current image is deeply disturbing, and it presents a major opportunity for Mamdani.

Arsenal’s chief sponsor is Emirates Airlines, owned by the Emirates Group, a state-owned Dubai-based holding company. Emirates is on the front of every jersey, and the team plays at Emirates Stadium in London. The United Arab Emirates has spent more than $1bn sponsoring the team, including expanding its contract through 2033 to more than $100m per season. Arsenal is the UAE’s second biggest sports investment globally.

The trouble is the UAE is also sponsoring a genocidal militia in Sudan, where war has created the world’s largest displacement crisis, with 14 million people, or a quarter of the country’s population, forced to flee their homes, and 21 million people facing acute hunger. The UAE has provided the militia, known as the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), with weapons and killer drones, according to numerous investigations. In fact, the UAE is the RSF’s biggest supplier of weapons and drones.

And therein lies the rub. The UAE is engaging in one of the world’s largest sportswashing campaigns in an attempt to clean up its image, including with Mamdani’s beloved Arsenal. The UAE’s sportswashing isn’t limited to the Gunners. We calculated that the UAE government has spent more than $5.2bn on sponsoring sports teams and leagues around the world, including Manchester City, the NBA champion New York Knicks (a team Mamdani also cheers for), the Emirates NBA Cup and Formula One. There are multiple other football, basketball, cycling, rugby, cricket and UAE-sponsored teams as well.

The good news is that Arsenal’s ownership isn’t blind to abusive sportswashing relationships. Last year, the club announced it was cutting its sleeve sponsor, Visit Rwanda, after the country’s invasion of the Democratic Republic of Congo and the humanitarian catastrophe that ensued as a result. More than 8 million people have been displaced from their homes, as Rwanda has invaded the DRC and commanded the deadly M23 militia that has tortured victims, engaged in extensive sexual violence and enlisted child soldiers. The Arsenal Supporters’ Trust weighed in on the issue, following campaign initiatives such as Gunners for Peace, and the owners changed course.

Now it’s time for Arsenal to tackle their bigger sportswashing sponsor, and Mamdani can play a key role. As one of the world’s most visible Arsenal fans, his voice would have an important impact on the club’s decision makers. The club’s owners are American, Josh and Stan Kroenke, and they have stood up in the past for human rights – for instance, calling for a lifetime ban on former Los Angeles Clippers owner Don Sterling for making racist remarks.

Mamdani could make the Kroenkes and the rest of the Arsenal board aware of the UAE’s sportswashing and call on them either publicly or privately to move on to another sponsor because of the genocidal militia the UAE is sponsoring in Sudan. The club is, after all, awash in cash after winning the league and reaching the final of the Champions League, earning $411m in total, a record for Arsenal. It is now reportedly the most profitable football club in England. So they don’t need the Emirati money.

Importantly, the UAE is not the only game in town for football sponsors – there are viable alternatives. Snapdragon, a Qualcomm tech company, pays approximately the same amount for sponsoring Manchester United as the Emirates pays Arsenal, and automaker Jeep and telecom company T-Mobile pay Juventus and Bayern Munich just a hair under.

Arsenal canceling the deal would also have a meaningful impact on the UAE and on the genocide unfolding in Sudan. The UAE is very sensitive to public image, and a cancelled Arsenal deal would be a major public relations blow. Mamdani’s intervention could have major human rights implications.

Mamdani is passionate about human rights, combating genocide and supporting his favorite team. Urging the club’s leadership to change its sponsor from the UAE would combine all three passions into one and potentially have a positive impact on the world’s deadliest humanitarian crisis. New Yorkers and Arsenal fans alike should encourage Mamdani to weigh in with the club on this important issue.
Sasha Lezhnev is Senior Policy Advisor at The Sentry, where John Prendergast is Co-Founder.

items.titleZh: 马姆达尼热爱阿森纳，他应当敦促俱乐部因苏丹问题切断与阿联酋的联系
items.summaryZh: 纽约市长马姆达尼对阿森纳的热爱与对人权的关注形成碰撞，这为其推动阿森纳终止阿联酋赞助提供了契机。
bodyZh: 无论你是否喜欢他，毫无疑问，纽约市长佐兰·马姆达尼对某些议题的热情是极具感染力的，正是这种热情在很大程度上帮助他赢得了选举。但如今，他的两大最大热情正处于一场碰撞之中。
一方面，马姆达尼可以说是美国最受关注的英超冠军阿森纳的超级支持者。作为一名从小到大的死忠球迷，他在当选市长后，将这支枪手球队带入了前所未有的美国聚光灯下。当阿森纳赢得英超冠军时，帝国大厦亮起了阿森纳的红白两色。他曾撰文讲述阿森纳的夺冠对他的意义，在记者会和采访中谈论阿森纳，并为了致敬这位阿森纳传奇，在时代广场附近为蒂埃里·亨利路（Thierry Henry Way）举行了揭牌仪式。
但马姆达尼的另一大热情——反对种族灭绝、捍卫人权——如今却为这位市长的阿森纳球迷身份带来了一个难题。阿森纳当前形象中一个显眼的组成部分令人深感不安，这也为马姆达尼带来了一个重大契机。
阿森纳的主要赞助商是阿联酋航空（Emirates Airlines），该公司隶属于总部位于迪拜的国有控股公司阿联酋航空集团。阿联酋航空的标志印在每件球衣的正面，球队在伦敦的酋长球场比赛。阿联酋已花费超过10亿美元赞助该球队，其中包括将合同延长至2033年、每赛季超过1.0亿美元的赞助。阿森纳是阿联酋在全球范围内的第二大体育投资。
问题在于，阿联酋同时也在苏丹资助一支实施种族灭绝的民兵武装。那里的战争引发了全球最大的流离失所危机，有1400万人（即该国四分之一的人口）被迫逃离家园，2100万人面临严重饥荒。多项调查显示，阿联酋向被称为快速支援部队（RSF）的民兵武装提供了武器和致命无人机。事实上，阿联酋正是该武装最大的武器和无人机供应商。

问题也恰恰在于此。阿联酋正在进行全球最大规模的“体育洗白”运动之一，企图以此改善自身形象，对象也包括马姆达尼深爱的阿森纳。阿联酋的体育洗白并不局限于枪手。据我们计算，阿联酋政府已在赞助全球各地的体育球队和联赛上花费超过52亿美元，包括曼城、NBA冠军纽约尼克斯队（这也是马姆达尼支持的一支球队）、阿联酋航空NBA杯以及一级方程式赛车。此外还有多支涉及足球、篮球、自行车、橄榄球、板球等由阿联酋赞助的队伍。

好消息是，阿森纳的所有权层并非对有害的体育洗白关系视而不见。去年，该俱乐部宣布在卢旺达入侵刚果民主共和国并引发人道主义灾难后，终止其球衣袖标赞助商“visit Rwanda”的合作。由于卢旺达入侵刚果民主共和国并指挥了残害受害者、大范围实施性暴力以及招募童兵的致命M23民兵武装，已有超过800万人流离失所。在“枪手争取和平”等球迷运动的推动下，阿森纳球迷信托基金（Arsenal Supporters’ Trust）也就此问题发声，随后俱乐部所有者改变了方针。
现在是阿森纳处理其规模更大的体育洗白赞助商的时候了，而马姆达尼可以发挥关键作用。作为世界上最受瞩目的阿森纳球迷之一，他的声音将对俱乐部的决策者产生重要影响。俱乐部的所有者是美国的乔什和斯坦·克伦克，他们过去曾为支持人权挺身而出——例如，曾因前洛杉矶快船队老板唐·斯特林发表种族歧视言论而呼吁对其实施终身禁赛。
马姆达尼可以促使克伦克家族以及阿森纳董事会的其他成员意识到阿联酋的体育洗白行为，并公开或私下呼吁他们由于阿联酋在苏丹资助种族灭绝民兵而更换赞助商。毕竟，在赢得联赛冠军并打入欧冠决赛、总共获得411万美元（创下阿森纳纪录）的收入后，该俱乐部目前资金充裕。据报道，它现在是英格兰最具盈利能力的足球俱乐部。因此，他们并不需要阿联酋的资金。
重要的是，阿联酋并不是足球赞助商的唯一选择——市场上存在可行的替代方案。高通旗下的科技公司骁龙（Snapdragon）为赞助曼联支付了与阿联酋航空赞助阿森纳大致相当的金额，汽车制造商吉普和电信公司T-Mobile对尤文图斯和拜仁慕尼黑的赞助金额也仅略低一点。
阿森纳取消这项协议也将对阿联酋以及苏丹正在发生的一场种族灭绝产生实质性影响。阿联酋对公众形象非常敏感，取消阿森纳的赞助协议将对其公共关系造成重大打击。马姆达尼的干预可能会对人权产生重大影响。
马姆达尼对人权充满热忱、致力于打击种族灭绝并支持自己最喜爱的球队。敦促俱乐部领导层将赞助商从阿联酋更换，将这三者热忱合为一体，并有可能对全球最致命的人道主义危机产生积极影响。纽约人和阿森纳球迷都应该鼓励马姆达尼在这个重要议题上向俱乐部施加影响。
萨沙·莱日涅夫（Sasha Lezhnev）是“哨兵组织”（The Sentry）的高级政策顾问，约翰·普伦德加斯特（John Prendergast）是该组织的联合创始人。

items.titleEn: Arteta relishing competition in our squad
items.summaryEn: The boss has enjoyed having options in various positions on the pitch
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta is enjoying the opportunity to utilise the depth of our first team squad, as we look to continue our 100% record at Emirates Stadium this season against Everton on Saturday.

We've won 11 of our first 13 competitive matches this season, including six out of seven in the Premier League, and the boss feels that our squad depth has been a key factor in our impressive start to the campaign.

"We have really good options because they're in the right mindset," the boss said on his squad, "I'm extremely proud of the chemistry and the desire we have created among the players who both start and finish the game.
"We've seen a great example with Ebz, who could have been upset and certainly was when he was substituted after 45 minutes at Forest, and then came in and made the impact he did on Wednesday.
"That's exactly what you need - you have a bench that can be strong as strong as you want, but they have to give you what you need."
Saturday's game will see our squad further bolstered by the returns of Piero Hincapie and Martin Zubimendi, who have been out since our win over Leeds at the start of October.
The boss is looking forward to welcoming both players back and increase the competition for places.

"Piero trained with us and he's available for tomorrow. [Zubimendi] had a few [opportunities], then he had the injury and it's true that he had one game where he was almost fully available to play some minutes.

"From now, he needs to earn the right to play, but he's been exceptional, whatever the role that he had to assume, and I expect that from every player, and he's a player that deserves more minutes at the moment."

Martin is competing to get into a midfield that has been full of goals so far this season, with Mikel Merino, Declan Rice, Bruno Guimaraes and Martin Odegaard all on the scoresheet so far this season.
Mikel has enjoyed seeing the goals come from all over the pitch this season and wants to see more going forward.
"It goes for all the midfielders. Martin [Odegaard] has already scored a few goals, Bruno has done the same, Declan has done the same.
"That's what we need in relation to the position they play on the day, that they have that licence and especially the aggression to penetrate and to damage the opposition."
Another area of competition for starts has come at right-back, with both Jurrien Timber and Ben White starting the season well.
Jurrien celebrated his 100th Arsenal appearance in our win over Nottingham Forest, while Ben is in line to play for us for the 200th time should he get into the action against Everton.
"It's a contribution between the two of them, and we're really lucky to have them both.
"I think the way they both started the season is really, really positive. They're giving us so much, and it's good numbers for them."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔期待队内良性竞争
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔表示享受拥有阵容深度的机会，并赞赏球员们的心态。
bodyZh: 主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔正享受着利用一线队阵容深度的机会，我们将于周六在酋长球场对阵埃弗顿，力争延续本赛季在主场的全胜纪录。
本赛季前13场各项赛事中我们赢了11场，其中包括英超联赛7战6胜，主帅认为阵容深度是我们赛季强势开局的关键因素。
主帅在谈到球队时表示：“我们拥有非常好的选择，因为他们的心态很正确。我对首发和替补球员之间建立的化学反应和渴望感到极其自豪。”
“我们看到了埃布泽（Ebz）的一个很好例子，他在对阵诺丁汉森林时半场被换下本可能会感到沮丧，但他随后在周三出场并发挥了作用。”
“这正是你所需要的——你可以拥有一个非常强大的替补席，但他们必须给你想要的东西。”
周六的比赛中，皮埃罗·欣卡皮耶和马丁·祖比门迪的复出将进一步增强我们的阵容实力，两人自10月初战胜利兹联以来一直缺阵。
主帅期待着这两名球员的回归，并进一步加剧位置竞争。
“皮埃罗和我们一起训练了，他明天可以出场。祖比门迪之前有过几次机会，然后他受伤了，确实有一场比赛他几乎完全可以上场踢几分钟。”
“从现在开始，他需要赢得比赛时间，但无论他扮演什么角色，他都表现得非常出色，我对每个球员都有这样的期望，他目前是一位值得更多出场时间的球员。”
马丁正在竞争一个本赛季进球如潮的中场位置，米克尔·梅里诺、德克兰·赖斯、布鲁诺·吉马良斯和马丁·厄德高本赛季都已取得进球。
米克尔很高兴看到本赛季各个位置都能进球，并希望未来能看到更多进球。
“这对所有中场球员都适用。马丁（厄德高）已经打进几个球，布鲁诺也是如此，德克兰也是如此。”
“这正是我们根据他们当天的场上位置所需要的，他们拥有这种自由度，尤其是前插和打击对手的侵略性。”
另一个首发位置的竞争领域在右后卫，尤里恩·廷贝尔和本·怀特本赛季都有出色的开局。
尤里恩在战胜诺丁汉森林的比赛中迎来了他在阿森纳的第100次出场，而本·怀特如果对阵埃弗顿出场，将迎来他的第200次代表阿森纳出场。
“这是他们两人的共同贡献，我们非常幸运能拥有他们两个。”
“我认为他们俩本赛季的开局方式非常非常积极。他们为我们贡献了太多，对他们来说这也是不错的数据。”

items.titleEn: Every word of Mikel Arteta's pre-Everton presser
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta faced the media at the Sobha Realty Training Centre ahead of our Premier League clash at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta faced the media on Friday afternoon ahead of tomorrow's Premier League clash against Everton at Emirates Stadium.

The boss discussed a range of topics at the Sobha Realty Training Centre, including Bukayo Saka's fitness, his time with Toffees boss David Moyes and the robust fixture schedule we're facing this season.
Here's everything our manager had to say:
on Saka's injury:He’s got another MRI this afternoon because he had quite a lot of fluid in the area so it was difficult to understand the extent of the injury, but we’ll know more probably tomorrow.

on how serious it is:Again, we need a few more scans and opinions from the specialist. Obviously when a player has to walk off the pitch, he’s struggling to walk without any pain, he’s restricted to movement, they are not good signs. So again, let’s be a little bit patient so we can give a definitive assessment and then let you know.
on Saka if driving an automatic car had any impact:He’s not changing gear? I’m happy that he can drive.

on if Dowman is an option on the right:It’s something inevitable, to go back to that memory and the feeling of the moment. That’s with us and that’s going to stay in the stadium for a long, long time I think. He’s training, and every time he’s got a moment to play, he’s showing that he’s a player who is going to impact the game, so for sure he’s going to have minutes.
on if he will start against the team he scored against in March:It would be a great story yeah, if we win the game especially.
on Eze's importance:
They’re all important; we know that. I’m extremely happy with how Ebz reacted to the previous game and the impact that he had on the team and the performance that he put in.

on wanting Rice to score more:Yes, but it goes for all the midfielders. Martin [Odegaard] has already scored a few goals, Bruno [Guimaraes] has done the same, Declan has done the same. That’s what we need in relation to the position they play on the day, that they have that license and especially the aggression to penetrate and to damage the opposition.

on White and Timber competing for right-back:It’s a contribution between the two of them, and we’re really lucky to have them both. I think the way they both started the season is really, really positive, they’re giving us so much, and yeah, it’s good numbers for them.

on if David Moyes is the king of the Premier League:100%; I don’t know if it’s the king or what it is, but he’s certainly someone that I think we all look up to. Not only for his longevity, but I think what he represents for the game, what he represents for the Premier League, and his trajectory. For me especially, because I know the man behind the coach, which is the most important thing, and then I really know as well the coach, and he’s a superb coach.

on seeing younger players show what they're capable of:[It’s] extremely fulfilling, because when you as well personally have had this experience and this trust and belief from somebody, it’s exactly what you need. But actually then you have to go out on the pitch and perform like you belong at that level, and against Bayern I really liked the way Myles came in. I think the composure, the presence and the way he helped the team to establish in the final third and play with so much personality. It’s another big step.

on having great options to turn to from the bench:We have really good options because they’re in the right mindset. I’m extremely proud of the chemistry and the desire we have created among the players who both start and finish the game. We’ve seen a great example with Ebz, who could have been upset and certainly was when he was substituted after 45 minutes at Forest and then came in and made the impact he did on Wednesday. That’s exactly what you need - you have a bench that can be as strong as you want, but they have to give you what you need.

on Everton’s biggest threats:There are a lot, because I know David so well and how he sets the team, the quality they have in their organisation and individually. It’s no coincidence they didn’t lose before their last game. They have a really good team, which we know because in recent clashes, it’s always been a really difficult game for us.

on if Saka is losing robustness:He’s certainly been different in the last year or so, but the demands that go into the players are immense with club and international competitions, and the time between games are getting narrower. There are less than 66 or 67 hours between games, and every hour is important. The support would be really appreciated, and it’s the same for every team.

on the short turnaround between games:We’re having three games in six days so we know what’s happening, especially when the games are so demanding and the necessity is to win. We know that, so we prepare the players for those scenarios and do the best we possibly can.

on if there’s a fear of Saka being burnt out:I don’t have that feeling at all, but certainly what we have to be very mindful of is to create the right ecosystem around a player to maximise his qualities. We need to understand what he’s capable of sustaining when he comes back, whenever that is.

on if people’s opinions of how our team plays matter to us:I think you have to respect every opponent - it would be good to be a bit consistent, but it’s understandable. It’s a game where we are passionate and emotional with what we’ve just seen. It’s normal, and you can forget what a team has just done. But that’s normal, that’s the expectation, and our job is to create constant excitement. The opponent has a lot to do with how they want to play, it’s inevitable, but it’s on us.

on if we want teams to have a go at us rather than sit back:Every team is going to prepare in the best way with how they think they can beat us, like we do with the opponent. You could have an open chance in the first 10 minutes that changes the game and then the next 80 minutes are different because of the context of the game, results have a huge impact on how teams behave. We need to be able to win and enjoy as much as possible in every context.

on what he said to Eze before he came on against Bayern:I think that stays between him and I on why I did it, and that’s it. But I think we get the best version of Ebz when he’s laughing, he’s happy and he’s himself.

on understanding what Eze needs:I think it's crucial that we do that. At least we are open to that because the more we connect with our players and we know how they are feeling and you can create that emotional connection between the coaches or whether it's the staff or between players obviously even more ideal. I think that's where the best version of yourself comes and then you feel understood and listened to and important and I think that's crucial to get performances.

on Rice owning the emotional dominance:I really see a step there on emotional dominance and control of Declan and it's something that I demand him to do because I know the person, I know the charisma and I think it's very important to set the bar especially when things are not where we want them to be and we are still chasing to do that and generate that belief and conviction in the team. I think he's done that really, really well.

on if Saka has to become a different kind of winger after his injuries:Not now, I don't know what's going to happen in the future. It's been muscles, it's been tendons as well which is something else. And that's not just with Bukayo, but with many other players as well and we discussed that last year, and that's why we need to keep an eye on him.

on how to lift Bukayo mentally:Today, it's just thinking: 'how can I help the team?' I already told him, go in that building and be the first one there with a good spirit and energy because that's what the team needs. If everybody's like: ‘Bukayo, how are you? Are you sick? Are you OK?’, that's exactly what we don't need. If this is what it is, this is part of our job: to have some nice and bad results, a defeat, a problem; we need to deal with that. We cannot change that now. What we certainly can do is dominate the narrative from here to the Everton game together,with the best energy and the spirit to go and win the game again.

on if Zubimendi is lacking opportunities at the moment:He had a few, then he had the injury. It's true that he had one game where he was almost fully available to play some minutes, not to start the game, and from now, he needs to earn the right to play. I need to find the right games to give him the opportunity and I know when I do that, what his response is going to be. But he's been exceptional, whatever the role that he had to assume, and I expect that from every player. He's a player that deserves more minutes at the moment.

on if Calafiori can start a third game in a row and if Hincapie is available:Yeah, he's ready. I think he's in a different place because he had a full pre-season as well and he's been available for every match. And Piero, he trained with us and he's available for tomorrow.

on how to build a team full of players with a resilient mentality:That's clear to the players. I think we know what the expectations are. We know that we prepare and face each opponent regardless of who it is, to beat them, and that's the objective and the focus. Things can happen throughout a game, things that we don't expect, things that we don't like, things that we have to overcome. So be it. If you want to win a lot of matches, you're going to have to face so many different kinds of situations, and I think the team is ready to do that.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛前新闻发布会重点内容
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔在索布哈地产训练基地出席了对阵埃弗顿的英超赛前新闻发布会。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔于周五下午出席了新闻发布会，展望了明天在酋长球场对阵埃弗顿的英超比赛。
主教练在索布哈地产训练基地讨论了一系列话题，包括萨卡的身体状况、他与太妃糖主帅大卫·莫耶斯的交情，以及本赛季我们面临的密集赛程。
以下是我们的主教练发表的全部言论：
关于萨卡的伤情：他今天下午要进行另一次核磁共振检查，因为该部位积液较多，所以很难了解伤势的严重程度，但我们可能在明天会有更多了解。
关于伤势有多严重：同样，我们需要更多的扫描和专家的意见。显然，当一名球员不得不离场时，他在走路时会感到疼痛，活动受限，这些都不是好迹象。所以再次强调，让我们保持一点耐心，以便我们能够给出最终评估，然后再通知大家。
关于萨卡开自动挡汽车是否有影响：他不用换挡？我很高兴他还能开车。
关于道曼是否是右路的备选：这是不可避免的事情，会让人回想起那个时刻的记忆和感觉。这种记忆与我们同在，我认为它将长久地留在球场里。他在训练，而且每次获得出场机会时，他都在展现出自己是一名能对比赛产生影响的球员，所以他肯定会获得出场时间。
关于他是否会首发出战曾攻破过球门的球队：如果能赢下比赛的话，这将是一个伟大的故事。
关于埃泽的重要性：
他们都很重要；我们都知道这一点。我非常高兴埃泽对上一场比赛的反应，以及他对球队产生的影响和他所表现出的状态。
关于希望赖斯进球更多：是的，但所有中场球员都是如此。马丁（厄德高）已经打进了一些进球，布鲁诺（吉马良斯）也一样，德克兰也是如此。这就是我们需要他们做到的，结合他们在场上的位置，他们拥有这种自由度，尤其是具有前插和制造威胁的侵略性。
关于本·怀特和廷贝尔竞争右后卫：这是他们两人的共同贡献，我们真的很幸运能拥有他们两个。我认为他们俩开启新赛季的方式非常非常积极，他们为我们贡献了太多，是的，这对他们来说是不错的数据。
关于大卫·莫耶斯是否是英超之王：百分之百；我不知道他算不算王或者别的什么，但他无疑是我们所有人都敬仰的人。不仅因为他的长寿，还因为他对这项运动的代表性、他对英超联赛的代表性以及他的职业生涯。对我来说尤其如此，因为我了解教练背后的这个人，这是最重要的事情，而且我也真正了解这位教练，他是一位极佳的教练。
关于看到年轻球员展现能力：[这]极其令人欣慰，因为当你个人也有过这种经历，并得到某人的信任和信念时，这正是你所需要的。但实际上，你必须到球场上去拿出表现，证明你配得上这个级别。对阵拜仁时，我真的很喜欢迈尔斯上场的方式。我认为他的沉着、存在感以及他帮助球队在前场建立进攻并展现个性的方式，是又迈出的一大步。
关于替补席上有出色的选择：我们有非常好的选择，因为他们的心态是正确的。我对球员们（无论是首发还是替补）之间建立的化学反应和渴望感到无比自豪。我们看到了埃泽就是一个很好的例子，他在森林队比赛45分钟后被换下时本可能会沮丧，也确实很沮丧，但周三上场后却产生了那样的影响。这正是你所需要的——你可以拥有你想要的强大替补席，但他们必须给你想要的东西。
关于埃弗顿的最大威胁：有很多，因为我非常了解大卫以及他如何部署球队，他们在组织和个人能力上都具备质量。他们在上一场比赛之前保持不败绝非巧合。他们是一支非常优秀的球队，我们对此很清楚，因为在最近的交锋中，对我们来说总是非常艰难的比赛。
关于萨卡是否在失去抗击打能力：在过去的一年左右，情况确实有所不同，但俱乐部和国际比赛给球员带来的要求是巨大的，比赛之间的间隔越来越短。比赛之间的间隔不到66或67小时，每一个小时都很重要。如果能得到支持将不胜感激，这对每支球队来说都是一样的。
关于比赛间隙期短：我们在六天内要踢三场比赛，所以我们知道发生了什么，尤其是当比赛要求很高且必须取胜时。我们知道这一点，所以我们为这些情况做好了准备，并尽我们所能做到最好。
关于是否担心萨卡被过度使用：我完全没有这种感觉，但我们绝对必须非常注意的是，在球员周围创造正确的生态系统，以最大化他的品质。无论何时他回归，我们需要了解他能够承受什么。
关于人们对我们球队踢球方式的看法是否重要：我认为你必须尊重每一个对手——如果能保持一点连贯性会很好，这是可以理解的。这是一项充满激情和情绪的比赛。这很正常，你可能会忘记一支球队刚刚做了什么。但那是正常的，那是期望，我们的工作是创造持续的兴奋感。对手对他们的踢法有很大影响，这是不可避免的，但这取决于我们。
关于我们是否希望对手主动进攻而不是死守：每支球队都会以他们认为能击败我们的最佳方式做好准备，就像我们对阵对手时一样。在前10分钟你可能会得到一个改变比赛的绝佳机会，然后由于比赛的背景，接下来的80分钟会有所不同，结果对球队的表现有巨大影响。我们需要能够在各种背景下尽可能多地赢球并享受比赛。
关于在对阵拜仁前对埃泽说了什么：我认为这留在他和我之间，关于我为什么这么做，仅此而已。但我认为，当埃泽大笑、快乐并做回自己时，我们能看到最好的他。
关于理解埃泽需要什么：我认为我们做到这一点至关重要。至少我们对此持开放态度，因为我们与球员的联系越多，我们了解他们的感受就越多，你就能在教练、工作人员或球员之间建立这种情感联系，这甚至更理想。我认为那是展现最好的自己的地方，然后你会觉得自己被理解、被倾听并且很重要，我认为这对发挥水平至关重要。
关于赖斯展现情感主导力：我确实看到德克兰在情感主导力和控制力方面迈出了一步，这是我要求他做到的，因为我了解这个人，我知道他的个人魅力，我认为设定标准非常重要，特别是当事情没有达到我们想要的标准，而我们仍在追求做到这一点并激发球队的信念和坚定决心时。我认为他做得非常非常出色。
关于萨卡受伤后是否必须成为另一种类型的边锋：现在不会，我不知道未来会发生什么。这既有肌肉问题，也有肌腱问题，这是另一回事。这不仅发生在布卡约身上，也发生在许多其他球员身上，我们去年讨论过这一点，这就是为什么我们需要密切关注他。

关于如何在精神上鼓舞布卡约：今天，只需思考：‘我该如何帮助球队？’我已经告诉过他，走进那栋大楼，带着良好的精神和能量成为第一个到那里的人，因为这正是球队所需要的。如果每个人都说：‘布卡约，你好吗？你生病了吗？你没事吧？’这正是我们不需要的。既然事情已经这样，这就是我们工作的一部分：会有好坏结果、失利、麻烦；我们需要处理这些。我们现在无法改变这一点。我们肯定能做的是，带着最好的能量和赢球的精神，一起主导从现在到对阵埃弗顿比赛的舆论走向。
关于祖比门迪目前是否缺乏机会：他有过几次机会，然后他受伤了。确实有一场比赛他几乎完全可以出场几分钟，而不是首发，从现在开始，他需要靠表现赢得比赛的权利。我需要找到合适的比赛来给他机会，我知道当我这样做时，他的反应会是什么。但无论他必须扮演什么角色，他都表现得非常出色，我对每个球员都有这种期望。目前他是一名配得上更多出场时间的球员。
关于卡拉菲奥里能否连续第三场首发以及因卡皮耶是否可以出场：是的，他准备好了。我认为他处于不同的境地，因为他也经历了完整的季前备战，并且每场比赛都可以出场。至于皮耶罗，他和我们一起训练了，明天可以出场。
关于如何打造一支具备坚韧精神的球员团队：这对球员们来说很清楚。我认为我们知道期望是什么。我们知道我们如何准备并面对每一个对手，无论他是谁，都要击败他们，这就是目标和重点。比赛中可能会发生一些事情，我们意料之外的事情，我们不喜欢的事情，我们必须克服的事情。那就这样吧。如果你想赢下很多比赛，你将不得不面对许多不同种类的情况，我认为球队已经准备好做到这一点。

items.titleEn: Arteta provides an update on Saka's injury
items.summaryEn: Bukayo Saka limped off early on against Bayern Munich and Mikel Arteta has addressed the issue in his pre-Everton press conference
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta said more time is needed to determine the severity of the injury Bukayo Saka sustained in our Champions League draw at Bayern Munich.
Our winger came off after 10 minutes at the Allianz Arena after picking up a muscle injury while playing a pass, and Mikel said after the match that it was "really bad news."
But after returning to England, Mikel has provided an update: Bukayo needs further assessment but will miss our game against Everton on Saturday.

“He’s got another MRI this afternoon because he had a lot of fluid,” Mikel said. “We need a few more scans and opinions from the specialists. Let’s be a little bit patient so we can give a definitive answer.

"We need a few more scans and opinions from the specialist. Obviously when a player has to walk off the pitch, he’s struggling to walk without any pain, he’s restricted to movement, they are not good signs. So again, let’s be a little bit patient so we can give a definitive assessment and then let you know."

When pressed on whether injuries are beginning to affect Bukayo's playing style, the boss added: "I don't know what's going to happen in the future. It's been muscles, it's been tendons as well which is something else. That's not just with Bukayo, with many other players as well. We discussed that last year and that's why we need to keep an eye on him.
But while he recuperates, Mikel wants one of our leaders to keep contributing to the squad by using his presence to keep the rest of the squad motivated and focused on future matches.

"I already told him to go to the [training ground] and be the first one there with a good spirit and energy because that's what the team needs. If everybody's like: ‘Bukayo, how are you? Are you sick? Are you OK?’, that's exactly what we don't need.

"If this is what it is, this is part of our job, to have some nice and bad results, a defeat or a problem, we need to deal with that. We cannot change that now. What we certainly can do is dominate the narrative from here to the Everton game together, with the best energy and the spirit to go and win the game."

Now attention has turned to who could fill in for Bukayo over the coming weeks. Ebere Eze replaced him in midweek and made an instant impression by netting in fine style to put us ahead, while more opportunities could come for Max Dowman, who famously scored his first Gunners goal in our 2-0 win against the Toffees in the equivalent fixture last season.

On his options, Mikel added: "They’re all important; we know that. I’m extremely happy with how Ebz reacted to the previous game and the impact that he had on the team and the performance that he put in.

[Max] is something inevitable, to go back to that memory and the feeling of the moment and that’s with us and that’s going to stay in the stadium for a long, long time I think. He’s training, and every time he’s got a moment to play, he’s showing that he’s a player that is going to impact the game, so for sure he’s going to have minutes."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔更新萨卡伤情
items.summaryZh: 萨卡在对阵拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中受伤离场，阿尔特塔出席赛前新闻发布会更新了情况。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔表示，需要更多时间来确定布卡约·萨卡在我们在欧冠对阵拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中遭遇的伤势严重程度。
我们的边锋在安联球场出场10分钟后，在传球时拉伤肌肉离场，米克尔在赛后表示这是“非常糟糕的消息”。
但在返回英格兰后，米克尔更新了情况：布卡约需要进一步评估，并将缺席我们周六对阵埃弗顿的比赛。
米克尔说：“他今天下午还要做一次核磁共振，因为有很多积液。我们需要专家的更多扫描结果和意见。让我们稍微有点耐心，以便我们能给出明确的答案。”
“我们需要专家的更多扫描结果和意见。显然，当一名球员不得不走下球场时，他在没有疼痛的情况下很难行走，他的活动受到了限制，这些都不是好迹象。所以再次强调，让我们保持一点耐心，以便我们能给出最终的评估并随后通知大家。”
当被问及伤病是否开始影响布卡约的踢球风格时，主教练补充道：“我不知道未来会发生什么。有肌肉问题，也有肌腱问题，这是另一回事。不仅是布卡约，许多其他球员也是如此。我们去年讨论过这一点，这就是为什么我们需要密切关注他。”
但在他康复期间，米克尔希望这位领袖之一继续为球队做出贡献，通过他的存在保持其他队员的动力，并专注于未来的比赛。
“我已经告诉他去训练基地，成为第一个到达那里并保持良好精神和能量的人，因为这正是球队所需要的。如果每个人都说：‘布卡约，你怎么样？你生病了吗？你还好吗？’这正是我们不需要的。”
“如果事情就是这样，这也是我们工作的一部分，会有好的和坏的结果，一场失利或一个问题，我们需要去处理它。我们现在无法改变这一点。我们肯定能做到的是，以最好的能量和精神，共同主导从现在到埃弗顿比赛之间的舆论走向，去赢得比赛。”
现在注意力转向了谁能在未来几周顶替布卡约。埃贝雷·埃泽在周中的比赛中替补上场，并以一记精彩的进球让我们领先，给人留下了即时印象，而马克斯·多曼可能会获得更多机会，他在上赛季同场对阵太妃糖的比赛中打入了他在阿森纳的处子球，那场比赛我们以2-0取胜。
关于他的选择，米克尔补充道：“他们都很重要；我们知道这一点。我非常高兴Ebz对上一场比赛的反应，以及他对球队产生的影响和他所表现出的水平。”
[马克斯]是不可避免的，回到那个记忆和当时的感觉得到了我们的共鸣，我想那种感觉会留在球场很长很长一段时间。他一直在训练，每次他有上场时间时，他都在证明他是一名能对比赛产生影响的球员，所以他肯定会获得出场时间。

items.titleEn: Help young supporter Zach receive life-saving treatment
items.summaryEn: We are encouraging our supporters to help the four-year-old Arsenal fan who has relapsed stage 4 neuroblastoma
bodyEn: We are encouraging our supporters to help a young Arsenal fan raise enough funds for life-saving treatment.

Zach, who is four years old and from Hackney, has relapsed stage 4 neuroblastoma, a rare and aggressive form of childhood cancer. He has until the start of November to raise £339,000 via registered charity Solving Kids Cancer, which would allow him to travel to Rome for life-saving CAR-T treatment.
His journey began in October 2024 when he was just two years and eight months old and was diagnosed with neuroblastoma, which affects around 100 children in the UK each year.

For children diagnosed with high-risk disease, treatment can be long and intensive, often involving several different therapies and procedures. Even after completing frontline treatment, there remains a significant risk of the cancer returning. For children whose cancer comes back, like Zach, the survival rate is much lower than for other childhood cancers.

Zach is a big Arsenal supporter alongside his older brother, and proudly wears his football shirt with his name on the back. He should have started reception this September, at the same school as his big brother, but instead, he is facing his second fight against cancer.

Since his diagnosis, Zach has undergone an incredibly intensive course of treatment, including chemotherapy, MIBG therapy, a 12-hour operation to remove his tumour and immunotherapy. He has needed numerous procedures under general anaesthetic, feeding tubes and treatment for several complicated infections

When our players visited Great Ormond Street last year, Zach was too ill with an infection to go and meet them. His big brother went in his place. However Zach and his family will be in attendance at Saturday’s Premier League game against Everton as a guest of the club, as we support the family's endeavours to raise the target amount.​​​​
If you’re able to donate to Zach’s cause, please do so here.

items.titleZh: 帮助年轻球迷扎克接受拯救生命的治疗
items.summaryZh: 我们鼓励球迷帮助四岁的阿森纳小球迷扎克筹集救命资金。
bodyZh: 我们正在鼓励广大球迷帮助一位年轻的阿森纳球迷筹集足够的资金以接受拯救生命的治疗。
扎克今年四岁，来自哈克尼，他患有的四期神经母细胞瘤不幸复发，这是一种罕见且极具侵袭性的儿童癌症。他必须在11月初之前，通过注册慈善机构Solving Kids Cancer筹集33.9万英镑，这将使他能够前往罗马接受挽救生命的CAR-T治疗。
他的抗癌历程始于2024年10月，当时他年仅两岁零八个月，被诊断出患有神经母细胞瘤。这种疾病每年在英国影响大约100名儿童。
对于被诊断患有高危疾病的儿童来说，治疗过程可能漫长而密集，通常涉及多种不同的疗法和程序。即使在完成一线治疗后，癌症复发的风险依然很高。对于像扎克这样癌症复发的儿童来说，其生存率远低于其他儿童癌症。
扎克和他的哥哥一样是阿森纳的超级球迷，并且自豪地穿着印有他名字的球衣。他本应在今年9月入学，和哥哥在同一所学校上学，但相反，他正在面临他人生的第二次抗癌之战。
自确诊以来，扎克经历了极其密集的治疗过程，包括化疗、MIBG疗法、长达12小时的肿瘤切除手术以及免疫疗法。他在全身麻醉下经历了无数次手术、插胃管以及针对几种复杂感染的治疗。
去年我们的球员访问大奥蒙德街医院时，扎克因为感染病情严重而无法前往与他们见面。他的哥哥代替他去了。然而，作为俱乐部的嘉宾，扎克和他的家人将出席周六对阵埃弗顿的英超比赛，我们将支持这家人为达成目标金额所做出的努力。

items.titleEn: U21s preview: Leicester City v Arsenal
items.summaryEn: We face the Foxes away from home in search of our first PL2 win of the season
bodyEn: Our under-21s are back in Premier League 2 action on Saturday evening (5pm UK) with a trip to Leicester City.
We'll be searching for our first win of the league season, with four draws and a defeat in our opening five fixtures.

With several players in our under-21s squad involved in our 3-3 draw with Bayern Munich in the UEFA Youth League on Wednesday, momentum is behind David Horseman's side as they look to record a PL2 win.
THE OPPOSITION
Leicester City have had a tough start to the season, taking just one point form their opening four games, scoring just one goal in the league.
Despite equalising away at Manchester United in the first round of the season, the young Foxes suffered a 4-1 defeat, before losing 3-0 to defending champions Brighton.

Things looked up the following week with a hard-earned 0-0 draw at home to West Ham, but a 2-0 defeat to Tottenham after the international break sent Leicester down to 30th in the 31-team league table.
That being said, the only point and clean sheet the Foxes have recorded this season did come in their only home fixture of the season against West Ham.
HOW TO FOLLOW
Live updates will be available before, during and after the match on our Academy X channel.
Post-match, a full match report and match highlights will be available on The Arsenal app and on Arsenal.com.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳U21将客场挑战莱斯特城，力争赛季首胜。
bodyZh: 我们的U21青年队将于周六晚（英国时间下午5点）客场挑战莱斯特城，重返英超2联赛的赛场。
球队将全力寻找本赛季联赛的首场胜利，我们在前五场比赛中取得了四平一负的战绩。
由于U21阵容中的多名球员参加了周三在欧洲青年联赛中3-3战平拜仁慕尼黑的比赛，戴维·霍斯曼的球队正带着这种势头，力争在英超2联赛中取得胜利。
对手情况
莱斯特城本赛季的开局十分艰难，在前四场比赛中仅拿到一分，且在联赛中只打进一球。
尽管在赛季首轮客场对阵曼联时一度扳平比分，但小狐狸军团随后以4-1落败，接着又以3-0输给卫冕冠军布莱顿。
随后一周情况有所好转，他们在主场以0-0顽强逼平西汉姆联，但在国际比赛日后以2-0不敌托特纳姆热刺，这让莱斯特城在31支球队的积分榜上跌至第30位。
话虽如此，莱斯特城本赛季获得唯一的积分和唯一一场零封，正是在其本赛季唯一的的主场对阵西汉姆联时取得的。
如何关注比赛
比赛前、中、后，我们的学院官方X频道将为您提供实时动态更新。
赛后，阿森纳官方App和Arsenal.com网站将提供完整的比赛战报和比赛集锦。
